integrity: The exact all-parameter proof is the cellular fixed-cube coefficient argument and the radial-tree homology theorem. The included finite enumeration corroborates, rather than substitutes for, the infinite proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only three distinct unordered particles and automorphisms permuting the arms of a topological star.
The known nonequivariant homotopy and rank theorem are acknowledged as prior results; only the complete rational arm-action character and its consequences are claimed.
The character does not supply a canonical integral cycle basis or extend to metric-spacing persistence.
Unindexed equivalent work is a residual originality risk.
title: The full arm-permutation character of three-point configurations on a star
